latexSmartTab.skipBlankChar.description: Allow Tab to cross whitespace before an eligible closing token.

latexSmartTab.enableMultilineMode.description: Allow Tab to find a closing token on the next nonblank line. In snippet mode it must still lie inside the current placeholder.

latexSmartTab.escapeTypedClosersAcrossPl.description: Let an immediately adjacent closer created by ordinary typing or auto-pairing escape before an outer snippet tab stop, even when it lies just beyond the current nested placeholder.

latexSmartTab.recoverSequentialArguments.description: Treat a closing brace followed by another balanced braced argument as a transition to that next argument instead of a cursor stop in the `}{` gap.

latexSmartTab.recoverLongLineSnippetPref.description: Recover exact static snippet prefixes that VS Code misses after more than 100 consecutive non-whitespace characters on a compact line.

latexSmartTab.prefixProbeCharacters.description: Characters allowed in the final prefix token used by long-line snippet recovery. The default covers the reviewed alphanumeric and semicolon-prefixed snippets.

latexSmartTab.preserveUntouchedTerminalD.description: When an untouched selected default is the terminal field of its creating snippet, Space preserves it and inserts a space after it. Earlier placeholders retain native replacement behavior.

latexSmartTab.closingTokens.description: Closing tokens that Smart Tab may cross, longest matches first.

latexSmartTab.exitBlockClosersToNextLine.description: When a standalone display-math closer is crossed, place the cursor on the following line instead of immediately after the closing token.

latexSmartTab.blockClosingTokens.description: Standalone block-level closing tokens whose exit target is the following line. Nested structures such as bmatrix and aligned are intentionally excluded.
